draft.name: Garage Door
draft.tagline: Spring, opener and door repair seeds for garage door businesses

checklist.label: Identify spring type, wire size and door weight before ordering or fitting
Secure the door closed before touching any spring hardware
Use correctly sized winding bars; never improvised tools
Offer to replace both springs as a pair and record the customer's choice
Balance test: the door stays put at mid-height without drifting
Inspect cables, drums and bottom brackets for wear
Photograph the finished installation

troubleshooting.symptom: Loud bang from the garage, then the door will not lift or feels extremely heavy
troubleshooting.safety: Do not try to lift the door, release the opener, or touch the springs, cables or brackets. They hold stored energy. Keep people and vehicles clear of the door and book a technician.

causes.label: Torsion spring worn out and broken
causes.test: Visible gap in the spring coil; door cannot be lifted by hand
causes.fix: Replace the spring set with the correct size and re-balance the door

causes.label: Lift cable snapped or off the drum
causes.test: Slack or frayed cable; cable not seated in the drum groove
causes.fix: Replace the cable and reseat the drum

causes.label: Centre or end bearing seized
causes.test: Shaft does not turn freely; bearing noise before failure
causes.fix: Replace the bearing and lubricate the shaft

price.description: Replace broken torsion springs and re-balance the door.

checklist.label: Confirm power, outlet and fuse before opening the housing
Check and align safety sensors; never bypass them
Set travel and force limits to the door manufacturer's guidance
Run the auto-reverse test with an obstruction
Re-pair remotes and keypad
Photograph the unit label and the finished work

troubleshooting.symptom: Opener hums, clicks, reverses, or does nothing when the button is pressed
troubleshooting.safety: Unplug the opener before opening the housing. Never bypass or tape over the safety sensors.

causes.label: Safety sensors misaligned or blocked
causes.test: Sensor LEDs off or blinking; door closes only when the button is held
causes.fix: Clean, realign and secure the sensors

causes.label: Remote battery or pairing lost
causes.test: Wall button works, remote does not
causes.fix: Replace the battery or re-pair the remote

causes.label: Travel limits out of adjustment
causes.test: Door stops short or reverses at the floor

causes.label: Logic board failure
causes.test: No response with good power and sensors
causes.fix: Replace the board or the opener

price.description: Diagnose and repair the garage door opener, sensors and remotes.

checklist.label: Secure the door and keep everyone clear before any work
Inspect rollers, hinges and tracks for damage
Assess panels; recommend replacement where a section is bent or cracked
Reset the door in the tracks and realign
Balance test before handing the door back
Photograph before and after

troubleshooting.symptom: Door is crooked, jammed or hanging out of its tracks
troubleshooting.safety: Do not operate the opener or stand under a door that has come off its track. Panels and springs can fall.

causes.label: Roller failed or slipped out of the track
causes.test: Missing or broken roller; door sits crooked on one side
causes.fix: Replace rollers and reset the door in the track

causes.label: Vehicle or object impact
causes.test: Bent track or panel at the point of impact
causes.fix: Replace the damaged track or panel section

causes.label: Track brackets loose
causes.test: Track moves by hand; gap to the jamb
causes.fix: Tighten or replace the brackets and re-level

price.description: Reset or repair a garage door that has come off its tracks.

checklist.label: Balance test with the opener disconnected
Inspect springs, cables, rollers and hinges
Lubricate moving parts with a garage-door-rated lubricant
Auto-reverse and sensor test
Leave a written condition report

price.description: Annual safety inspection, balance test and lubrication.

dispatchNotes: Broken spring or door off its track with a person or vehicle affected: same-day priority. Tell the caller not to touch the door, springs or cables.
Door stuck open overnight is a security issue: offer the next available priority slot.
Opener problems are routine: schedule normally unless the door is stuck open or has a vehicle trapped inside.
